name: Moth Chair
tagline: Booking a tattoo shouldn't feel like negotiating in someone's DMs.
positioning: Moth Chair is the booking layer for independent tattoo artists and the people who sit for them — deposits, flash drops, and consent forms, minus the group chat.

hero.h1: Stop running your booking book out of your DMs.
hero.sub: Moth Chair takes deposits, drops flash, screens tire-kickers, and sends aftercare — so the only conversation left is where the tattoo goes.

features.title: Deposits that actually land
features.description: Collect a non-refundable deposit before the appointment is real. No-shows forfeit it automatically, and you never have to type 'per my last message' again.

features.title: Flash drops with a waitlist
features.description: Post a sheet, set the quantity, and let clients claim designs first-come. Sold-out pieces auto-close so nobody double-books your best snake.

features.title: A calendar that respects your day
features.description: Buffers, healing gaps, and 'do not book me before noon' rules baked in. Clients only see the slots you'd actually agree to.

features.title: Consent forms, signed in advance
features.description: ID check, medical questions, and release form done on the phone before they sit down — not scribbled on a clipboard while you glove up.

features.title: Aftercare that texts itself
features.description: Automatic healing check-ins at day 3, 14, and 30, plus a nudge for the healed photo you keep forgetting to ask for.

features.title: Every client, one clean history
features.description: Past pieces, allergies, deposits paid, and that one time they rescheduled four times — all in a profile you can actually read.

testimonials.quote: I used to lose two hours a day answering 'how much for a small one?' Now the deposit clears before I even see the reference photo. My DMs are quiet and my rent is early.
testimonials.name: Renata Voss

testimonials.quote: The no-show rate at our shop dropped off a cliff. Turns out people show up when they've already put money down. Who knew.
testimonials.name: Dominic Ashe

testimonials.quote: Flash drops on Moth Chair sold out my whole Friday sheet in nine minutes. I've never felt more like a concert and less like a small business.
testimonials.name: Priya Nadkarni

pricing.blurb: For the one-chair operation who is also the receptionist.
For working artists who want the whole book on autopilot.
For multi-artist shops with a front desk and opinions.

homepage.footerBlurb: Moth Chair runs the boring half of tattooing so you can get back to the needle. Deposits, drops, and forms — handled.
